channel.title: Developer Journal | Dinesh Kumar M B
channel.description: Engineering notes, architecture decisions, and lessons learned while building Full-Stack MERN and AI-powered applications.

item.title: Building an AI-Powered EMI Management & Loan Intelligence Platform with RAG
item.description: Deep dive into designing a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline with Gemini AI, indexing loan policy documents into ChromaDB, and coupling precise financial calculation engines with LLM synthesis.

item.title: How I Built TaskFlow — An AI-Powered Sprint Management SaaS
item.description: Architecture breakdown of a Jira-inspired sprint management platform featuring role-based access control, Cashfree recurring billing integration, and natural-language-to-JSON AI ticketing.

item.title: Building InnoIDE: Lessons From Creating a Visual Engineering Platform
item.description: Behind the scenes of building a web-based IDE featuring React Flow interactive canvas nodes, WebSockets state synchronization, and Dyte WebRTC video pair-programming.

item.title: Building an AI Code Reviewer: Architecture, AI Integration and Engineering Lessons
item.description: How I built an automated pair-programming code review assistant using Express.js, Google Gemini API, and React, focusing on prompt engineering for security vulnerabilities and syntax analysis.

item.title: Building an AI Mock Interview Application: From User Flow to AI Feedback
item.description: Engineering an interactive interview practice platform featuring browser Web Speech API voice transcription, Clerk user management, and dynamic Gemini AI evaluation.

item.title: Engineering Real-Time Peer-to-Peer Communication with Streamify
item.description: Understanding WebRTC peer connection handshakes, STUN/TURN server signaling via Socket.IO, and end-to-end encrypted audio/video streaming in MERN applications.
